items.exampleEn: The program helps young workers achieve their aspirations.
items.exampleZh: 這個計畫幫助年輕員工實現他們的抱負。

items.exampleEn: The museum is run independently, without money from the government.
items.exampleZh: 這間博物館獨立經營，沒有拿政府的錢。

items.exampleEn: Many of our daily choices are unconscious.
items.exampleZh: 我們每天的許多選擇都是無意識的。

items.exampleEn: The new parking fees caused outrage among local people.
items.exampleZh: 新的停車費引起當地居民的憤慨。

items.exampleEn: I was surprised by my own ignorance about how my phone works.
items.exampleZh: 我很驚訝，自己對手機怎麼運作竟然一無所知。

items.exampleEn: Online shopping late at night is a big temptation for me.
items.exampleZh: 深夜網購對我來說是很大的誘惑。

items.exampleEn: With a determined look, the little boy tried the jump again.
items.exampleZh: 小男孩帶著堅決的神情，又試跳了一次。

items.exampleEn: I felt like an idiot when I called my boss by the wrong name.
items.exampleZh: 我叫錯老闆的名字時，覺得自己像個白痴。

items.sentenceEn: Children often copy their parents' unconscious habits.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子常會模仿父母不自覺的習慣。

items.audioEn: I'm determined to save enough money for a trip to Japan next year.
items.audioZh: 我下定決心要存夠錢，明年去日本旅行。
items.questionZh: 說話者下定決心要做什麼？
options: Find a new job next year

items.sentenceEn: Each student must do the project independently, without help.
items.sentenceZh: 每個學生都必須獨立完成這個專案，不能找人幫忙。

items.sentenceEn: Please forgive my ignorance, but what does this word mean?
items.sentenceZh: 請原諒我的無知，這個字是什麼意思？

items.stemEn: Working in another country has always been my greatest ____.
items.stemZh: 到另一個國家工作一直是我最大的志向。

items.stemEn: Don't call your little brother an ____; it isn't kind.
items.stemZh: 別叫你弟弟白痴，那樣不好。

items.passageEn: When she was a teenager, Nina's aspiration was to become a chef. Her parents wanted her to study law, but she was determined to follow her dream. At cooking school, she learned to work independently and to cook with great dedication. When she opened her first restaurant, she faced the temptation to use cheaper ingredients to save money, but she refused. Once, a food writer called her an idiot for using simple local vegetables, and many customers expressed outrage at his rude review. Nina simply laughed. She says such criticism often comes from ignorance of local food, and she never takes it personally.
items.passageZh: Nina 十幾歲時，志向就是當廚師。她的父母希望她念法律，但她下定決心要追求夢想。在烹飪學校，她學會獨立工作，並全心投入地做菜。開第一家餐廳時，她面臨用便宜食材省錢的誘惑，但她拒絕了。有一次，一位美食作家罵她是白痴，因為她用的是簡單的在地蔬菜，許多顧客都對他無禮的評論感到憤慨。Nina 只是笑了笑。她說，這類批評常常來自對在地食物的無知，她從不放在心上。

questions.questionZh: Nina 的父母希望她做什麼？
美食作家批評 Nina 時，許多顧客有什麼反應？
options: 從此不再來這家餐廳用餐
對他無禮的評論感到非常憤慨
也同意他對在地蔬菜的看法

items.promptZh: 看到美食時，我很難抗拒誘惑。
referenceEn: It is hard for me to resist temptation when I see good food.
I find it hard to resist the temptation of good food.
rubricZh: temptation 的用法，例如 resist temptation、the temptation of／to… 等
「很難」可寫，例如 It is hard for me to…、I find it hard to… 等

items.promptZh: 那支球隊下定決心要贏回冠軍。
referenceEn: The team is determined to win the title back.
The team is determined to win back the championship.
rubricZh: determined 是形容詞，常接 to＋原形動詞（例如 is determined to win 等）
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）
「冠軍」可寫，例如 the title、the championship 等
